entities.name: Gunnar Bärlund
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gunnar Richard Bernhard Bärlund was a Finnish heavyweight boxer who won the European amateur title in 1934. He competed in the 1932 Summer Olympics, but lost in the first round to the eventual winner Santiago Lovell.
